name: Iris Chalkbinder
lore: A travelling tutor who carries enchanted chalk and turns forgotten lessons into pathways of light.

primary.name: Chalkstroke
primary.description: Draw a 250-unit chalk line over 0.45s. It lasts 4s and damages each enemy touching it once for 16. Keep up to three lines; walls stop the drawing.

secondary.name: Erase & Release
secondary.description: Erase your chalk lines. Each releases two seeking chalk shards for 12 damage each. With no lines, release one shard.

special.name: Living Blackboard
special.description: Draw a 300 by 220 grid ahead for 4s. Enemies inside move 35% slower and take 7 damage every half-second. Walls block its damage.

passive: Second Draft: Erase & Release heals you for 3 health per erased line.

technique.name: Patient Chalk
technique.description: Chalk lines remain 50% longer, but deal 20% less contact damage.

final_technique.name: The Last Underline
final_technique.description: Draw a charged 72-damage underline that slows for 1s. Replaces the chalk grid with one narrow piercing sentence.

attack.name: The Last Underline
attack.description: Draw a charged 72-damage underline that slows for 1s. Replaces the chalk grid with one narrow piercing sentence.
